sloka: अयोनिजां हि मां ज्ञात्वा नाध्यगच्छद्विचिन्तयन् ।सदृशं चानुरूपं च महीपाल: पतिं मम ॥ २.११८.३७॥
transliteration: ayonijāṁ hi māṁ jñātvā nādhyagacchadvicintayan ।sadṛśaṁ cānurūpaṁ ca mahīpāla: patiṁ mama ॥ 2.118.37॥

translations.english: The ruler of the earth knew that I was not born from a woman's womb, and could not find a suitable husband for me after deep reflection.
